title: ECI Position to AER
text: Convert Earth-centered inertial (ECI) coordinates to azimuth coordinates, 6 inputs, 1 output, {Month} sets Month; {Reduction}, {Year}, {Day}, {Hour}, {Minutes}, {Seconds}, {Time increment}, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior, {Higher accuracy parameters} enables higher accuracy parameters, {Units}, {Earth model}, {Flattening}, {Equatorial radius} sets the radius of planet at equator, {Initial geodetic latitude and longitude [deg]} sets the initial geodetic latitude and longitude, {Angular direction of the local reference system (degrees clockwise from north)} and {Reference height}. Values come from the instance.
